BEFORE YOU GET BUILDING

A few good
questions.

A little clarity, from the start.

What does the DevCon agent do?+

DevCon helps you understand what to build next. Give it an idea or an existing repository, and it returns an ordered plan, contextual coding prompts, and reasons for steps that don’t apply.

Can I use it with an existing project?+

Yes. DevCon is designed for both new ideas and existing repositories. The plan takes your project’s context into account.

Does DevCon write and deploy my code?+

The experience shown here focuses on understanding, planning, and coding prompts. It doesn’t demonstrate autonomous code editing or deployment. Open the app to see the current early-access experience.

Which kinds of projects is it for?+

Side projects, academic work, hackathons, and commercial projects. Different contexts use the same underlying catalog, with steps tailored to what applies.

Is DevCon available yet?+

DevCon is in early access. Open the app for the current experience and access options. All project plans on this page are illustrative examples.
